Release persistence harness lacked a test helper and water texture cache; terrain planner lacked stream/backend dependencies. Setup repaired; underlying pre-existing unfinished-lake shutdown/ID assertions still fail on both pre-repair and repaired binaries.

dictionary_repair.cause: Pinned godot-cpp Dictionary move assignment overwrites old backing storage; deque middle erasure deterministically retained 48/80 NativeBlockMapRegion wrappers. Binding repair alone gives 0/80; explicit dictionary ownership transfer under worker mutex follows. Prior clear() tests concealed shared ownership leaks.

legacy_persistence.status: Both builds fail the same two known assertions: unfinished-lake shutdown capture and deleted persistent lake ID reuse. Already tracked in WORLD_FOUNDATION_STATUS; not a new regression and not closed.

dictionary_repair.packaged: Four serial strict package runs pass after repair (2 short, 1 longer GPU-profile/verbose, 1 longer without GPU-profile/verbose); normal saves succeed, zero ObjectDB leaks, all process-specific sampled resource limits pass. This closes the reproduced ownership defect, not arbitrary-session or other lifetime issues.

export.image_outputs: No generated icon or geometry output changed; two manifests refreshed native source hashes only.

remaining_stalls.status: The 480 ms interval did not repeat without verbose/GPU profiling; no causal attribution from a single negative repeat. No new pipelines and trace writer inactive during these worst frames. Triggered windows only, offscreen 1080p: not an unbiased whole-session/foreground FPS qualification.

dictionary_repair.gpu_pass_scope: Available engine profiling buckets from long world run including the full turn; not a controlled per-pass optimization comparison.
dictionary_repair.final_pursuit: Packaged moving-goal recalculation, narrow-aisle route response and furnished-room moving-target pursuit pass using the final native/PCK hashes. Release sampling and capability/collision contracts also pass. The earlier 13-check saved tower round trip validates the route fixes before the binding repair; cold 35-45 second planning remains unacceptable.
